answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in island, expire in anchor, and zephyr lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 47 aliases hence needs 132 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2873 identities would post 3188 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
